en: Water expands about 1,700 times in volume when it boils from a liquid to steam at 100 degrees Celsius.
Diamond is the hardest natural solid material on Earth, scoring a perfect 10 on the Mohs hardness scale.
One liter of seawater from Manila Bay contains about 33 grams of dissolved salts, mostly sodium chloride.
Reacting one gram of baking soda with excess vinegar produces roughly 280 milliliters of carbon dioxide gas at room temperature.
Osmium is the densest naturally occurring element, weighing 22.6 grams per cubic centimeter, which is twice as dense as lead.
Tungsten has the highest melting point of all pure metals, remaining solid until it reaches 3,422 degrees Celsius.
Earth's atmosphere is a mixture of gases containing approximately 78 percent nitrogen and 21 percent oxygen by volume.
Unlike most liquids, water expands by about 9 percent in volume when it freezes into solid ice.
At room temperature, liquid honey is about 10,000 times more viscous than water, causing it to flow much slower.
Dry ice is solid carbon dioxide that sublimates directly into gas at negative 78.5 degrees Celsius.
At 20 degrees Celsius, a maximum of 360 grams of table salt can dissolve in one liter of pure water.
Silver is the best electrical conductor among all metals, conducting electricity slightly better than copper, which ranks second.
